translation.about_p_16: I grew up with hands that seek texture — fingers drawn to the surface of things, to the roughness hidden beneath smoothness. From a young age I understood that painting for me is not an occupation, but a way of being in the world. Every work I create is a conversation between material and emotion, between layer and layer, between what is seen by the eye and what is felt by the heart.
translation.about_p_17: My artworks are born from a world of color, texture and depth. I believe that true art doesn't explain itself — it invites you to enter it, to touch, to breathe. Every painting that leaves my studio carries within it layers of intention, of beauty built slowly, of luxury that is felt before it is seen.
translation.about_p_18: "Good art doesn't decorate the room — it changes the energy within it. It tells a story you can't stop listening to."
translation.about_p_19: Every artwork is born from layers — layer upon layer of material, color, and texture — until the surface takes on a life of its own. In my works I combine mixed-media techniques with texture paste, palette knife, acrylic and gold leaf, creating luxury textured artwork that invites the gaze to wander and the hand to touch. Every detail is calculated, every depth intentional — because true art must feel the way it looks.
translation.about_p_20: We'll talk about the space, about the colors, about what you feel when you enter it.
translation.about_p_21: I'll send you an initial sketch and color palette created especially for your space.
